pages.title: Accordion
pages.description: Allows you to display content in a collapsible manner, making it easy for users to access information while conserving screen space.

pages.title: Alert
pages.description: Alerts often appear between inputs or around the important UI elements to convey critical information, such as an incorrect password during login attempts.

pages.title: Avatar
pages.description: Avatar is an image that represents a user or organization.

pages.title: Avatar Group
pages.description: Avatar group displays two or more avatars in an inline stack.

pages.title: Avatar Group Compact
pages.description: More compact version of AvatarGroup.

pages.title: Badge
pages.description: A badge is a piece of text that is visually stylized to differentiate it as contextual metadata. It can be used to add a status, category, or other metadata to a design.

pages.title: Banner
pages.description: Delivering crucial alerts and information prominently at the top of the screen.

pages.title: Breadcrumb
pages.description: Guiding users by displaying their path within an app or website.

pages.title: Button
pages.description: Renders a button or an element styled to resemble a button.

pages.title: Button Group
pages.description: Button groups are a set of buttons sticked together in a horizontal line.

pages.title: Checkbox
pages.description: Checkbox is a form control for single and multiple selections.

pages.title: Color Picker
pages.description: Choose or create specific colors with this versatile tool for various design needs.

pages.title: Command Menu
pages.description: Command Menu empowers users to swiftly execute searches on any page, thereby streamlining their workflow.

pages.title: Compact Button
pages.description: Buttons that are ideal for when space is limited.

pages.title: Data Table
pages.description: Data table is a 2-dimensional data structure where each row is an item, and each column is a data point about the item.

pages.title: Datepicker
pages.description: Enabling users to choose either a single date or a range of dates.

pages.title: Digit Input
pages.description: A component for entering one-time passwords (OTPs) in a digit-by-digit manner. Ideal for secure authentication flows where users need to input short numeric codes.

pages.title: Divider
pages.description: A versatile divider component used to create visual separation between content.

pages.title: Dot Stepper
pages.description: Very minimal stepper. Often used as carousel dots.

pages.title: Drawer
pages.description: A panel which slides out from the edge of the screen.

pages.title: Dropdown
pages.description: Displays a menu to the user—such as a set of actions or functions—triggered by a button.

pages.title: Fancy Button
pages.description: Regular buttons with a fancy appearance.

pages.title: File Upload
pages.description: A consistent way to drag and drop, as well as browse your computer to upload a media file.

pages.title: Hint
pages.description: Hint components provide contextual information or guidance beneath inputs, selects, and textareas, enhancing usability and user experience.

pages.title: Horizontal Stepper
pages.description: A versatile horizontal step indicator providing a clear visual guide through sequential processes.

pages.title: Input
pages.description: Text input is used to set a value that is a single line of text.

pages.title: Kbd
pages.description: A very simple component for displaying keyboard key styling.

pages.title: Label
pages.description: Labels provide context for user inputs.

pages.title: Link Button
pages.description: Buttons that seamlessly integrate with text content.

pages.title: Modal
pages.description: Modal is a floating surface used to display transient content such as confirmation actions, selection options, and more.

pages.title: Notification
pages.description: Notifications typically appear temporarily in corners, conveying information like payment and update notifications.

pages.title: Pagination
pages.description: Pagination is a horizontal set of links to navigate paginated content.

pages.title: Popover
pages.description: Popover is used to bring attention to specific user interface elements.

pages.title: Progress Bar
pages.description: A progress bar is a simple chart that can be used to show how complete something is.

pages.title: Progress Circle
pages.description: A progress circle is a simple chart that can be used to show how complete something is.

pages.title: Radio
pages.description: Radio button is a form control for making a single selection from a short list of options.

pages.title: Rating
pages.description: The Rating Component offers a dynamic and visually engaging way for users to express their opinions.

pages.title: Segmented Control
pages.description: Segmented control is used to pick one choice from a linear set of closely related choices, and immediately apply that selection.

pages.title: Select
pages.description: Select is an input for selecting a single option from a menu.

pages.title: Slider
pages.description: Allowing precise selection of a single value within a specified range.

pages.title: Status Badge
pages.description: Allows you to visually highlight statuses or conditions within a confined screen space.

pages.title: Switch
pages.description: Switch is used to immediately toggle a setting on or off.

pages.title: Tab Menu Horizontal
pages.description: Provides a linear layout for making it easy to switch between sections or categories.

pages.title: Tab Menu Vertical
pages.description: Provides a stacked layout for making it easy to switch between sections or categories.

pages.title: Tag
pages.description: Efficient tool for categorizing and labeling content within your application.

pages.title: Textarea
pages.description: Renders a textarea with custom resize handle and character length display.

pages.title: Toast
pages.description: Multiple notifications may stack up as Toasts, delivering brief feedback in a compact size.

pages.title: Tooltip
pages.description: Tooltips add additional context to interactive UI elements and appear on mouse hover or keyboard focus.

pages.title: Vertical Stepper
pages.description: An adaptable vertical step indicator offering an intuitive progression representation for diverse layouts.

pages.title: cn
pages.description: Utilities for combining classNames with Tailwind v4's improved class conflict resolution.

pages.title: Polymorphic
pages.description: Utility types for creating strongly typed polymorphic components.

pages.title: recursiveCloneChildren
pages.description: Recursively clones children, adding additional props to components with matched display names.

pages.title: tv
pages.description: An instance of tailwind-variants with Tailwind v4 compatible class merging.
